'''Tormod Ernst Dittmar Førland''' (6 June 1920 – 10 November 1995) was a Norwegian chemist, a researcher in inorganic and [[physical chemistry]], and professor at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]].

==Personal life==
Førland was born in [[Høyland Municipality]] (now part of [[Sandnes Municipality]]) on 6 June 1920, a son of chemical engineer Tormod Reinert Førland and Berta Josefine Dittmar. In 1943 he married {{ill|Katrine Seip Førland|no|lt=Katrine Seip}}, a daughter of [[Didrik Arup Seip]].<ref name="nbl">{{cite encyclopedia |title=Tormod Førland |encyclopedia=[[Norsk biografisk leksikon]] |publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget |location=Oslo |url=https://nbl.snl.no/Tormod_Førland |editor-last=Helle |editor-first=Knut |editor-link=Knut Helle |language=Norwegian |first1=Marit |last1=Trætteberg |authorlink=Marit Trætteberg |accessdate=29 March 2021}}</ref>

==Career==
Førland graduated as chemical engineer from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] in 1946, and as [[Doctor of Science|dr. techn.]] in 1958. From 1947 to 1950 he attended universities in the United States, first the [[Carnegie Institute of Technology]] and then [[Pennsylvania State University]]. He was appointed as docent at the Norwegian Institute of Technology from 1959, and as professor of [[physical chemistry]] from 1963.<ref name=nbl/><ref name="snl">{{cite encyclopedia |title=Tormod Førland |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=https://www.snl.no/Tormod_Førland |last=Pedersen |first=Bjørn |editor-last=Bolstad |editor-first=Erik |language=Norwegian |authorlink=Bjørn Pedersen |accessdate=29 March 2021}}</ref>

His research interests included [[oxygen]] ion activity, [[electrochemistry]] and irreversible [[thermodynamics]].<ref name=snl/> He was awarded the [[Gunnerus Medal]] in 1991.<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |title=Gunnerus-medaljen |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=https://snl.no/Gunnerus-medaljen |editor-last=Bolstad |editor-first=Erik |language=Norwegian |accessdate=29 March 2021}}</ref>
